post.description:
**This is the source of truth for payment status.**

Paymob calls this endpoint after a transaction completes (success, failure, refund, void). The request body is HMAC-SHA512 signed using the instance's HMAC secret.

**Security:**
- The endpoint is public (no JWT) — security relies entirely on HMAC verification
- If HMAC is invalid, the request is rejected with 401
- The webhook is idempotent — replaying the same payload does not double-process

**How to test:**
1. Expose your local server via ngrok: `ngrok http 3000`
2. Set `PAYMOB_WEBHOOK_BASE_URL` to your ngrok URL
3. Configure the instance's `notification_url` per-intention (done automatically)
4. Complete a test payment — Paymob will POST to this endpoint

Alternatively, use Paymob's Webhook Testing Tool in the dashboard to simulate callbacks.

parameters.name: instanceId
parameters.description: Instance ID — used to look up the correct HMAC secret for verification. Extracted from the JWT claim when the intention was created.

requestBody.description: Paymob callback JSON payload. The `hmac` field is the HMAC-SHA512 signature to verify.

200.description: Webhook received and processed. Always returns 200 to acknowledge receipt (even if HMAC fails — in that case an exception is thrown).

401.description: HMAC verification failed — signature does not match the instance's HMAC secret.

get.description:
Paymob redirects the student's browser here after the checkout flow completes. **This is NOT the source of truth for payment status.**

The redirect contains query params (paymentId, success) that are purely for UX. The actual payment status is confirmed via the POST webhook at /payments/webhook/paymob/:instanceId.

The student is redirected to the frontend with the status in the URL.

info.title: Basma API
info.description:
Educational platform backend — multi-tenant, white-labeled

---

### WebSocket Chat (`/chat` namespace)

**Protocol**: socket.io | **Auth**: JWT via `socket.handshake.auth.token`

**Client → Server** (ack responses):
| Event | Payload | Ack |
|---|---|---|
| `joinGroup` | `JoinGroupDto` | `{ event: "joined", data: { groupId } }` |
| `leaveGroup` | `JoinGroupDto` | `{ event: "left", data: { groupId } }` |
| `sendMessage` | `SendMessageDto` | `{ event: "messageSent", data: Message }` |
| `typing` | `TypingDto` | `{ event: "typingAck", data: { groupId, isTyping } }` |

**Server → Client** (broadcast to `group:{groupId}`):
| Event | Payload | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `newMessage` | `MessageResponseDto` | New message in group |
| `typingIndicator` | `{ senderId, senderName, senderRole, groupId, isTyping }` | Typing status (excludes sender) |
| `error` | `{ message: string }` | Error notification |

**Test page**: [`/api/ws-test`](/api/ws-test)

secretKey.description: Paymob Secret Key — found in Dashboard → Settings → Secret Key. Use sk_test_... for test mode, sk_live_... for live.

publicKey.description: Paymob Public Key — found in Dashboard → Settings → Public Key. Use pk_test_... for test mode, pk_live_... for live.

hmacSecret.description: Paymob HMAC Secret — found in Dashboard → Settings → HMAC. Used to verify webhook signatures (SHA-512).

cardIntegrationId.description: Card Integration ID — found in Developers → Payment Integrations → Card. The numeric ID for your card payment integration (e.g. Visa/Mastercard, 3D Secure).

walletIntegrationId.description: Wallet/Mobile Integration ID — found in Developers → Payment Integrations → Wallet. The numeric ID for mobile wallet payments (e.g. Vodafone Cash, Orange Money). Optional — only needed if you accept wallet payments.

mode.description: Operation mode — "test" for sandbox (test credentials), "live" for production (real money). Must match the key prefix (sk_test_ / sk_live_).

isConfigured.description: Whether Paymob has been fully configured and is ready to accept payments

secretKey.description: Secret Key (masked) — only first 4 and last 4 characters are shown for security

publicKey.description: Public Key (masked) — only first 4 and last 4 characters are shown for security

cardIntegrationId.description: Card Integration ID — numeric ID for card payment processing

walletIntegrationId.description: Wallet/Mobile Integration ID — numeric ID for wallet payment processing

accountNumber.description: Account number (phone for wallets) or Instapay handle/phone
Account number (masked in student list, full after initiation)

courseId.description: ID of the course the student wants to pay for in order to get enrolled. The course must have a price > 0 and the student must not already be enrolled.

metadata.description: Additional metadata as JSON string — will be passed to Paymob extras field and returned in webhook callbacks.

status.description: Payment status — will be PROCESSING once intention is created

clientSecret.description: Client secret — pass this to Paymob Unified Checkout

checkoutUrl.description: Full Unified Checkout URL — redirect the student to this URL to complete payment

studentId.description: Student ID to record payment for

courseId.description: Course ID this payment is for

studentId.description: Student ID who made the payment

student.description: Student details (included in single payment view)

paymobIntentionId.description: Paymob intention ID — returned when creating the intention

paymobOrderId.description: Paymob order ID (= intention_order_id) — used to correlate webhooks to payments

paymobTransactionId.description: Paymob transaction ID — populated after successful payment via webhook

clientSecret.description: Client secret — used to launch Paymob Unified Checkout on the frontend

checkoutUrl.description: Paymob Unified Checkout URL — redirect the student here to complete payment

metadata.description: Additional metadata stored with the payment

total.description: Total number of payments matching the filter (not just the current page)

totalPending.description: Number of payments in PENDING or PROCESSING state

totalRefunded.description: Number of refunded or partially refunded payments

revenueCents.description: Sum of all paid amounts in cents

courseId.description: ID of the course the student wants to enroll in

teacherPaymentMethodId.description: ID of the teacher payment method the student wants to use

accountNumber.description: Full account number or Instapay handle for payment

notes.example: Payment not received in my account

amountCents.description: Amount in cents to refund. Defaults to the full payment amount. Partial refunds are supported (set to less than the original amount).

success.description: Transaction success status — this is the authoritative field (true/false)

error_occured.description: Whether an error occurred (Paymob spelling: one r)

has_parent_transaction.description: Whether this transaction has a parent (e.g. refund)

integration_id.description: Integration ID used for this transaction

is_auth.description: Whether this is an Auth transaction

is_capture.description: Whether this is a Capture transaction

is_standalone_payment.description: Whether this is a standalone payment

is_refund.description: Whether this is a refund transaction

owner.description: Merchant ID that owns this transaction

obj.description: Top-level object containing transaction + order info

order_id.description: Order ID (used in GET callbacks — alternative to obj.order.id)

merchant_order_id.description: The special_reference / merchant order ID you set when creating the intention

hmac.description: HMAC signature — must be verified against your HMAC secret

received.description: Whether the webhook was received and processed

elementIds.description: Element IDs in new order (must include all elements)

bodyJson.description: Rich content body JSON (for RICH_CONTENT type)
